quests.title: The Muster
description: Bring a shield and food, then choose an expedition. Open each gate in clear terrain away from your settlement. Fight together and collect the crest after the last wave.

quests.title: The Thornwood Supplies
description: A forest's iron and a trophy forged in flame open the gate. Expect wraiths among the redcaps.

quests.title: The Thornwood Gate
description: Combine two of the listed supply, this material and two ender pearls in a crafting table. Find the matching trial pearl in JEI.

quests.title: The Thornwood Crest
description: Open the matching pearl and defeat all three waves. Pick up the crest to record the win, then keep it for the Convergence Forge.

quests.title: The High Sky Supplies
description: Enchant gravitite at an Aether altar and pair it with ambrosium. Bring a bow for the cockatrices and give the sentries room.

quests.title: The High Sky Gate
description: Combine two of the listed supply, this material and two ender pearls in a crafting table. Find the matching trial pearl in JEI.

quests.title: The High Sky Crest
description: Open the matching pearl and defeat all three waves. Pick up the crest to record the win, then keep it for the Convergence Forge.

quests.title: The Echo Supplies
description: Return from the Otherside with resonarium plates and a reinforced echo shard. Keep clear of the stalkers as their pack closes in.

quests.title: The Echo Gate
description: Combine two of the listed supply, this material and two ender pearls in a crafting table. Find the matching trial pearl in JEI.

quests.title: The Echo Crest
description: Open the matching pearl and defeat all three waves. Pick up the crest to record the win, then keep it for the Convergence Forge.

quests.title: Three Gates, One Company
description: Bring the three crests together. After the quest records them, take them to the Forge to cast the Keystone.

quests.title: Found the Forge
description: Craft the Convergence Forge controller. Place it between two brass blocks. Above that row, place crying obsidian, brass, then crying obsidian. Face the controller outward.

quests.title: A Line from the Grid
description: Run a Universal Cable from your energy network to an exposed face of the controller. A Mekanism cube can buffer the supply.

quests.title: A Line from the Grove
description: Feed a Mana Spreader from a pool and bind the spreader to the controller with a Wand of the Forest. Give the spreader a clear shot at an exposed face.

quests.title: Metal from Two Worlds
description: Load eight brass ingots, one terrasteel ingot and two ostrum ingots. The Forge draws 200,000 FE and 12,000 mana to cast four Convergence Alloy.

quests.title: Glass of the High Sky
description: Forge two alloy, eight ambrosium and two mana diamonds at 400,000 FE and 30,000 mana. A spare lens crafts into four Warp Stones with two amethyst shards.

quests.title: The Convergence Keystone
description: Load a lens, all three trial crests, two calorite ingots and one Gaia ingot. Give the Forge 1,000,000 FE and 75,000 mana. The finished Keystone can become a beacon with glass and obsidian.

quests.title: The Vinteum Trade
description: Mine and refine vinteum. Trade the finished metal with a villager for the Codex Arcana, then follow its First Steps.

quests.title: Inscribe a Design
description: Build an Inscription Table. Set the shape, components and reagents for a first spell.

quests.title: Trace the Weave
description: Follow a manaweave pattern from the Codex. Draw each line cleanly before beginning the next.

quests.title: Wake the Wood
description: Assemble a wickerwood construct with a head, torso, legs and arms. Animate it when the parts are in place.

quests.title: Give Shape to Mana
description: Complete the first spell using the recipe written at the Inscription Table.

quests.title: The Weaving Altar
description: Build the Manaweaving Altar and complete a recipe using its required patterns.

quests.title: A Workshop with Hands
description: Use the Bell of Bidding to bind your construct to a Delegation Station or Lodestar. Give it a job it has the parts to perform.

quests.title: The First Casting
description: Equip your completed spell and cast it on an appropriate target.

quests.title: Apprentice
description: Fulfil the Codex's first tier requirements and perform its advancement ritual.

quests.title: Wood and Stone
description: Advance to tier two and animate a construct with the stronger wood and stone parts.

quests.title: The Rune Forge
description: Use the Rune Forge to make a rune and keep the pattern for later work.

quests.title: Journeyman
description: Reach tier three through the Codex and choose the faction whose work suits you.

quests.title: Iron and Gold
description: Build and animate an iron and gold construct to carry the workshop's harder jobs.

quests.title: An Etching that Holds
description: Use runic enchanting to apply an enchantment to a piece of equipment.

quests.title: Adept
description: Follow your faction's chapter through the next tier ritual.

quests.title: Obsidian Crew
description: Finish your construct line by animating a body of diamond and obsidian.

quests.title: Catch the Wellspring
description: Find an Eldrin Wellspring and build the Codex's capture structure around it.

quests.title: Master Artificer
description: Complete the final tier ritual and take your place among the master artificers.

quests.title: The Trainer Card
description: Craft a Trainer Card and read its standings. When it glows, follow the arrow toward your next key opponent.

quests.title: The First Match
description: Challenge a roaming trainer and win your first match.

quests.title: Brock
description: Prepare an answer to rock types and clear your first leader battle.

quests.title: Misty
description: Bring a team that can handle water opponents.

quests.title: Lt. Surge
description: Train a ground-type answer before taking on the electric team.

quests.title: Erika
description: Prepare for grass Pokémon and status effects.

quests.title: Koga
description: Bring a plan for poison pressure and a team that can finish decisively.

quests.title: Sabrina
description: Put a reliable psychic counter into your lineup.

quests.title: Blaine
description: Bring a team that can stay in the fight under fire.

quests.title: Clair
description: Prepare several answers to dragons before the last leader match.

quests.title: The Elite Four
description: Win four Elite Four matchups. Build a balanced roster with coverage for each fight.

quests.title: A League Champion
description: Defeat a Champion after the Elite Four. The Trainer Card tracks your next opponents.

quests.title: A Rival's Test
description: Win the battle against Terry and keep training the Pokémon that carried the match.

quests.title: Team Rocket
description: Beat a member of Team Rocket. Keep a spare team ready for encounters between leader matches.

quests.title: The Rocket Boss
description: Defeat Giovanni in the first Rocket boss match when your Trainer Card points to him.

quests.title: The Surveyor's Kit
description: Bring a spyglass and a way home. Search uncharted lands with an Explorer's Compass and step inside each site to record it.

quests.title: The Hunter's Cabin
description: Survey the cabin and take stock before heading further from the road.

quests.title: The Ancient Mines
description: Descend with light and spare pickaxes. Follow the workings into the lower galleries.

quests.title: Tinker's Workshop
description: Investigate the old machinery. Follow moving parts from a safe position before crossing them.

quests.title: The Tinker's Citadel
description: Reach the citadel and search its upper works. Carry a return route and keep a spare set of tools.

quests.title: The Apothecary
description: Step into the old apothecary and look for the tools of the local trade.

quests.title: The Archmage's Tower
description: Approach the tower with a way out. Search for supplies worth bringing back to your scriptorium.

quests.title: The Necromancer's Spire
description: Scale the spire and reach the heart of the ruin. Bring healing and room to retreat.

quests.title: Bearclaw Inn
description: Find the inn and establish a place to regroup before heading into hostile country.

quests.title: Pillager Fortress
description: Cross the perimeter and explore the fortress. Ranged cover helps in its exposed approaches.

quests.title: The Labyrinth
description: Enter with spare light and mark your route through the maze.

quests.title: Fisherman's Lodge
description: Chart a lodge on the water and prepare supplies for your dive.

quests.title: The Sunken Ship
description: Dive to the wreck. Look for pockets of air and check your route to the surface.

quests.title: The Ruins of the Deep
description: Reach the ruins below the sea and return with a route your crew can follow.

quests.title: The Far Roads
description: Record the four expeditions in your journal. Bring back a story from each route for the next traveler.

quests.title: A Camera for the Road
description: Craft a camera and sneak-use it to fit a roll of film. Use the viewfinder to frame your first shot.

quests.title: The First Frame
description: Expose a frame with a loaded camera.

quests.title: Into the Darkroom
description: Develop an exposed roll using the ingredients listed on its film tooltip.

quests.title: A Print to Keep
description: Put the developed roll into a Lightroom and print a frame with paper and dye.

quests.title: The Color of Home
description: Expose and develop a roll of color film. Use cyan, magenta and yellow dyes to print a color frame.

quests.title: Light in the Dark
description: Attach a redstone lamp and use the flash to expose a frame in darkness.

quests.title: An Album for the Crew
description: Craft an album and bind several of your expedition prints together.

quests.title: Light from the Void
description: Take a photograph in the End. Return with the film and develop it safely at home.

quests.title: The Wildlife Archive
description: Photograph the wild animals tracked by the Wildlife Archivist advancement.

quests.title: A Gallery of Worlds
description: Display a series of framed photos from three different dimensions. Leave captions with each location so visitors can follow your route.
